topic: How do GEO vs LEO satellite orbits affect latency and coverage in hybrid networks for rural substation monitoring?
response: GEO orbits introduce higher latency (~250-280 ms) due to their distance, while LEO orbits offer lower latency (~20-30 ms). LEO constellations provide global coverage with hundreds of satellites, making them suitable for rural substation monitoring with enhanced data rates and reduced delays.
reference_context: LEO satellites offer reduced delay and global coverage, making them suitable for rural areas, while GEO satellites have higher latency due to their distance from Earth.
